claims: 404 Day in Atlanta occurs on April 4.
404 Day in Atlanta is an annual celebration.
404 Day is named after Atlanta's original area code.
The 2026 404 Day celebration often features a parade from Peachtree Street to Underground Atlanta.
The 2nd Annual 404 Day Parade is held in downtown Atlanta.
The 2nd Annual 404 Day Parade features local artists, businesses, and community groups.
